subject: Request: Temporary on-call coverage & escalation matrix for weekend maintenance
messages:
From: Samantha Ng <samantha.ng@acmecourier.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary P1 response exception for planned data migration (Mar 18-19)

Hi Lauren,

Heads up — AcmeCourier has a planned cross-region data migration on the weekend of Mar 18-19. During the busiest migration windows (02:00-07:00 PT on both days) we'll have elevated alert noise from schedulers and some non-customer-impacting background jobs. Our engineering team has asked whether Redwood can approve a temporary modification to the P1 response SLA for those windows: specifically, allow a 30-minute P1 response window (instead of the standard 15) for that 10-hour period each day.

We understand this is an exception request and we're proposing compensating controls:
- Dedicated incident bridge and primary escalation to our on-call infra lead (Paul Reynolds)
- Pre-signed fallback to a read-only mode for affected endpoints (as per mitigation plan)
- Post-migration validation run and joint RCA if anything slips

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept this temporary change and what approvals you need? We also can share the migration runbook and a short list of the alert signatures that will fire so you can tune thresholds.

Thanks,
Samantha Ng
Head of Platform Ops
AcmeCourier

Attachments: migration_runbook_v3.pdf (attached to original)
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 16:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary P1 response exception for planned data migration (Mar 18-19)

Team — forwarding Acme's exception request. Key asks: temporary widening of P1 window to 30 minutes for two windows (02:00-07:00 PT, both days). They propose compensating controls and an incident bridge.

Can we do the following by Monday?
1) Confirm whether we can approve the exception under our enterprise contract (notes on whether this requires CSM/Legal sign-off)
2) Draft an internal escalation matrix that maps who covers the bridge and tiered fallbacks if the primary on-call is unreachable
3) Decide whether dedicated monitoring adjustments or temporary suppression rules are acceptable (and who will apply them)

I think this is low risk if we pair it with the mitigation plan, but want ops coverage and an explicit escalation path. Ben — can you propose an on-call swap or overtime plan? Marissa — can you draft the escalation matrix? Karthik — any T&Cs we should flag for Legal/Finance?

Thanks — Lauren
VP, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 11 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary P1 response exception for planned data migration (Mar 18-19)

+1 on approving conditionally. Operational notes:
- I can cover the Mar 18 overnight bridge (02:00-07:00 PT) if Marissa or Karthik can take Mar 19; otherwise we'll need to offer Acme a paid on-call augmentation or push for a narrower window.
- Suggested mitigation: require Acme to provide a Slack bridge with explicit paging rules and a direct dial for their infra lead (Paul). We should also get their alert list at least 48 hours prior so SRE can tune suppression rules.
- Cost/finance: temporary SL adjustments that are purely response-window changes (no change to uptime/credits) are allowed under our contract without Finance approval. If they request credits or SLA credits, loop in Legal/Finance immediately.

Also: we should keep a short paper trail approving the exception and list responsibilities. If Marissa can draft the matrix and I can sign the operational side, we can send a single note back to Acme.

Ben Carter
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 11 Mar 2028 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary P1 response exception for planned data migration (Mar 18-19)

Draft escalation matrix attached (escalation_matrix_v1.xlsx) and a short mitigation outline (downtime_mitigation_plan.pdf). Highlights:
- Primary on-call: Ben Carter (initial 02:00-03:30 PT), backup: Marissa Cole (03:30-05:00 PT), tertiary: Karthik Iyer (05:00-07:00 PT) — this spreads load and ensures overlap for handoffs.
- Paging policy: page primary once, if no ack in 10 minutes page backup, if no ack in 20 minutes page tertiary and open incident bridge.
- Escalation steps: 0-30m triage, 30-90m mitigation (apply suppressions/read-only), >90m open executive bridge and notify CSM.
- Required inputs from Acme: alert signature list (by Tue 03/15 EOD), Slack bridge invite + escalation numbers, and confirmation of the read-only fallback flag.

I also recommend we require Acme to accept joint RCA and a small post-mortem playbook item stating we won't extend the exception beyond the two windows without a formal request.

I'll mark the docs for signatures and can convert the matrix into an inline table for their Legal if they need it.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: escalation_matrix_v1.xlsx, downtime_mitigation_plan.pdf
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: Samantha Ng <samantha.ng@acmecourier.com>, Paul Reynolds <paul.reynolds@acmecourier.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: temporary P1 response exception for planned data migration (Mar 18-19)

Hi Samantha / Paul — thanks for the heads up and the runbook. We've reviewed this internally and can approve a temporary modification to the P1 response window for the specific migration windows you listed (02:00-07:00 PT on Mar 18 and Mar 19) with the following conditions:

1) Acme provides the alert signature list and Slack bridge invite by Tue 2028-03-15 23:59 PT.
2) Acme confirms the read-only fallback flag is tested on a staging cut on Mar 16.
3) Paging/escalation matrix will be as attached (escalation_matrix_v1.xlsx). Primary/backup/tertiary on-call responsibilities are agreed and documented.
4) This is a temporary, narrowly scoped exception only for the two windows; any extension or credits would require a separate written request.

Operational notes: Ben will take the initial coverage on Mar 18, Marissa will take Mar 19 overlap as backup, Karthik will be the tertiary escalation. If your primary contact (Paul) is unreachable we will follow the paging escalation in the attached matrix and open an executive bridge after 90 minutes.

Please confirm acceptance of these conditions and share the required artifacts. We'll prepare a short signed note to append to the SLA as an amendment.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
VP, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: escalation_matrix_v1.xlsx, downtime_mitigation_plan.pdf
